rounds.contract_for_phase_2: ATTEMPT_KINDS decides who writes the counted row. kind ai (any lesson with aiGrader or diagram.aiGrader): the ONLY counted row is the one grade-written writes with the grader totals; the browser POST to /api/lesson-submissions for the same try is acknowledged (200, recorded:"server") and NOT stored, except a gradingFailed marker (stored, NULL score, free). So an AI-graded console/chart part must call /api/grade-written for every graded try and must not rely on its own recordSubmission for the score or the count. kind client (no aiGrader, e.g. group builds): counted row from recordSubmission, score clamped to 0..possible else NULL. kind quiz: server scores. lesson_state score is always server-derived on a capped part.

rounds.design: ONE counting rule on both sides: SQL uses CASE WHEN json_valid(grade_json) THEN json_type(grade_json,'$.gradingFailed') END = 'true', identical to countAttempts' top-level === true. Any key matching /gradingfailed/i (NFKC, letters only) at any depth is refused 400 unless it is the exact top-level server-trusted marker. A marker is refused 409 once counted tries >= cap, for every kind. WrittenGrader stops writing a marker on a 409/capReached response. For the 'ai' kind the browser still writes the outage marker below the cap: grade-written (Phase 2's file) does not write markers itself, so moving that write server-side is reported, not done.

fix.1: SAFE PART FIXED: attempt-reveal and the capped path of quiz-reveal call mayReadAnswer: a teacher/admin always, a student only while enrolled in a live (unexpired, unarchived) class AND the lesson passes isLessonAvailableForStudent (open date, early-access override). A throwaway account gets 403 with nothing in the body. NOT done: the uncapped one-row quiz-reveal path (one-shot test, its fixtures predate enrolment, same weakness: one junk row opens the key). OPEN, USER DECISION: release only after the part's due date / a teacher release. It would slot into mayReadAnswer as one more condition: resolveDueForStudent(env, request, email, lessonId) is null or < now, OR a teacher-release row, evaluated after the enrolment check; for finding 4 the condition is per part GROUP (chart + build + write of one problem), so the due date of the LAST sibling gates the first.
fix.2: FIXED: one rule. SQL: CASE WHEN json_valid(grade_json) THEN json_type(grade_json,'$.gradingFailed') IS NOT 'true' END (exact key, exact JSON true), same as countAttempts' === true. findMarkerKey (NFKC, letters-only, any depth) refuses any gradingfailed-looking key with 400 once the exact top-level marker has been handled. Tests: GRADINGFAILED, gradingfailed, nested, fullwidth, grading_failed, inside an array, a non-true value; plus JS/SQL agreement on rows {GRADINGFAILED:true}, {gradingFailed:1}, {gradingFailed:'true'}.
fix.3: FIXED: the marker goes through the same conditional INSERT...SELECT as a counted try, so once counted >= cap it is 409 (every kind), and markers at cap-1 are free and leave the last real try. WrittenGrader no longer writes a marker for a capReached refusal (sets attempts to the cap instead). lesson-unsubmit now reads the latest NON-marker row. NOT done (reported): the 'ai' kind still lets the BROWSER write the outage marker below the cap, because grade-written.ts (Phase 2's file) does not write markers itself; moving that write server-side needs a grade-written edit. The gradebook still reads the latest row only, so a below-cap outage marker after a real try shows 'pending' (pre-existing behaviour).
fix.4: NOT BUILT: user decision (same gate as finding 1, per part group).
fix.5a: NOT FIXED: components/DiagramAssignmentView.tsx is the Phase 2 agent's file. Needed there: await recordSubmission first, then recordLessonCompleted, and for a 'client' kind let the server derive the best (lesson-state already ignores the browser score on capped lessons, so only the ORDER matters).
fix.5b: FIXED: QuizView spends a try only for a row the server accepted (else re-reads the count: hook gained refresh()); completion follows the RECORDED row, not the reveal fetch; a mount effect completes the part once if a counted row exists and lesson_state is not completed.
